page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8i.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server instance powered by dedicated x86_64 Intel Xeon 8475B processors operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz. Configured with 24 dedicated vCPUs and 48.0 GB of system memory, the instance maintains a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio (2.0 GB per core). It runs on KVM hypervisor architecture and does not feature dedicated graphics acceleration or local NVMe/SSD storage. Network throughput is backed by a 15 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, though complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

From a cost and hardware allocation standpoint, the compute-heavy 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU distribution delivers high processing density without incurring the additional cost of excess unneeded memory or bundled local drives. The lack of integrated local storage necessitates reliance on external block storage services for persistent data requirements. This hardware profile makes the ecs.c8i.6xlarge instance well suited for compute-bound operations, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, batch processing engines, ETL workflows, and web application serving where processing speed takes precedence over large memory footprints.
